summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Jan 2.4/550)

data.turoyo: Aṯi u amro da tre. Aṯi u amro komər: "Terhəs edilmeyecekler. Ikinci emire kadar bekleyin (Lə kowe, d miraxsi, hul d oṯe u amro da tre ṭər, ṭər mitaklən.)"
data.translation: The second order came. The order came, it says, ‘Terhis edilmeyecekler. İkinci emire kadar bekleyin. (They cannot be discharged; until the second order comes, let them, let them be kept.)’

rationale: New II Detransitive Infectum box and sense, in Turoyo rendition of a military order.

summary: New box Imperativ: example for sense 1b in Imperativ (Jan 2.4/552)

data.turoyo: Hul d aṯi u amro da tre, mərre: "Mraxesunne!"
data.translation: until the second order came and they said, ‘Discharge them!’

rationale: New II Imperativ and technical subsense 1b; direct discharge command.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 2.4/753)

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: U mede, d fayəš b boli, gədumarnoxyo. Bu ḥtiyat hawli taqriban tleṯi əšne. Səmlan i ʕaskariye ba tloṯ w tleṯi (1933). U yarḥo dann arbʕo azzano b nisən, 14 bu yarḥo dann 4 i šato dann 34 (1934) mraxsina.
data.translation: Father Brahim: What has remained in my mind, I will tell you. At the reserve call-up I was approximately thirty years old. We did military service in thirty-three, 1933. In the fourth month—we went in April—on the fourteenth of the fourth month in the year thirty-four, 1934, we were discharged.

rationale: New II Detransitive Preterit; explicitly dated discharge event.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 2.4/844)

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: E. Əno, i naqqa d mraxsina, kayəwli. Bi ḥarayto azzano lu maydan di ṭiyara, mawbəlallan l Muġla w Anṭalya, i naqqa du tarxis diḏan. Annaqqa mən səmlan? Səmlan mede tahlika, Ǧan, ġalabe...
data.translation: Father Brahim: Yes. I, when we were discharged, fell ill. At the end we went to the airfield; they took us to Muğla and Antalya at the time of our discharge. Then what did we do? We did something dangerous, Jan, very…

rationale: Second contextualized II Detransitive Preterit; when-clause and tarxis noun confirm discharge.

summary: New sense 1b: jmdn. aus dem Militärdienst entlassen
rationale: Institutional release has the serviceman as affected person, not merely permission content; recurring tarxis context supports a specialised subsense of erlauben.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) aus dem Militärdienst entlassen werden; entlassen sein

data.gloss: (Detrans.) aus dem Militärdienst entlassen werden; entlassen sein

rationale: Repeated agentless military-discharge uses with first-person and plural servicemen; related active release is 1b.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (24/135)

data.turoyo: Mraxṣile, məlle: "Izux b šlomo! Iḏa d oṯe, d məsnəqutu l mede ḥreno, ayko d huwetu, moḏeʕəlli!"
data.translation: Dann gab er ihnen Urlaub und sprach: "Gehet in Frieden! Wenn ihr noch etwas mehr braucht, so laßt es mich wissen, wo ihr auch seid!''

rationale: Third Preterit example; leave granted is followed by an explicit farewell command, giving independent context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (112/9)

data.turoyo: <...> D howe b lebayxu d mraxṣitulli ʕal u ṣaydano, ġalabe me lebi yo.”
data.translation: <...> Wenn ihr im Sinne habt, mir Urlaub zur Jagd zu geben, so ist mir das sehr nach dem Herzen.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell and explicit ʕal-marked activity complement, unlike existing d-clause content.

summary: example for sense 1b in Infectum (Jan 2.4/956)

data.turoyo: Ǧan: Abuna, i naqqa d mkamalxun tamo, d mraxəṣanxu, naqla ḥreto baq qamyonat mawbəlanxu?
data.translation: Jan: Father, when you finished there, when they discharged you, did they take you again in the lorries?

rationale: New active II Infectum 1b cell with second-person servicemen object.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 2.16/3549)

data.turoyo: W lu Mafəryono lə mraxaṣle b haṯe. Hedi azze mḥalaqle ruḥe, məltaǧele su qašyano d ʕAbdal Aġa. Bu ṭruno aʕḏo, u ṭruno, yaʕni u ṭruno, u ǧasur maṯkur d howe waṣiṭa, bi səbbaṯe d moyəd rəxṣa, rəxṣa yaʕni mu mafəryono hə.
data.translation: And the maphrian did not allow him this. Then he went, threw himself, sought refuge with that cruel man Abdal Agha. With this tyrant, the tyrant, that is, the tyrant, the bold man mentioned, so that he would be an intermediary, through him he might take permission, permission from the maphrian, you see.

rationale: Thin II Preterit sense 1 after three retained examples; l-marked actor and b haṯe permission content.

summary: The eight attestations retain II.1 erlauben. Six are already quoted; the two additions add independent departure and hunting-permission contexts.

Permittee L-suffixes are distinct from L-series Preterit agents (24/130). Content may be a d-clause, departure expression bu mazlo d-, or ʕal plus activity at112/9; the latter does not change the verb's permission meaning.
Infectum-wa occurs in unrealized conditional permission with law or d-, not as habitual permission in these examples.
Inherited examples lack numeric labels but the stem has one sense; counts use implicit1.

Military discharge recurs in one interview and in active commands, active affected-person clauses and agentless Detransitive forms. These are recurrent textual attestations, not necessarily separate historical discharge events.
Institutional release is treated as 1b under permission; ordinary ecclesiastical permission at 3549 stays 1. No gloss replacement or active renumbering is needed.
Preserve non-emphatic s in miraxsi/mraxsina/Mraxesunne alongside ṣ in mraxəṣanxu. Turkish terhis/tarxis provides contact-register context but does not establish the Turoyo morphology by itself.
The mraxsi state at 1014 is compatible with discharge but cannot decide Preterit versus Part. Pass. without a copula or paradigm evidence; no speculative Part. Pass. box is added.

24/135: confirm the exact segmentation/person values of Mraxṣile. Discourse gives a permission grant to departing travellers, but the supplied -ile does not independently establish the reader's claimed third-person recipient number.
112/9: is ʕal plus activity productive with this verb, or chiefly with ṣaydo? One attestation does not establish a new construction meaning.
Confirm miraxsi/mraxsina as II Detransitive forms and the source s/ṣ variation rather than a distinct military loan paradigm.
At Jan 2.4/1014 is mraxsi a finite Detransitive Preterit plural or a Part. Pass. state? No Part. Pass. box is proposed until confirmed.
